question: Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan is also known as ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tansen of the 20th century.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan**

 
 
• Indian Hindustani classical vocalist, from the** Patiala Gharana.**
 
• Patiala Gharana was founded in the **mid to late 19th century** by his** great-grandfather Mian Kallu.**
 
• His** pen name: Sabrang**
 
• He was awarded by
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (1962)**
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi fellow (1967)**
 
• **Padma Bhushan Award (1962)**
 
 
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Tansen**

 
 
• **Miyan Tan Sen or Ramtanu Pande** was a prominent figure of** Hindustani classical music**.
 
• He brings down the rains with** Raga Megh Malhar** and lighting lamps by performing **Raga Deepak.**
 
• He was one of the **navratna of Emperor Akbar.**
 
• A **crater on the planet Mercury** has been named in his honour.
